## Summary

Adds a monthly GitHub Action that counts the previous month's issues and pull requests and opens an issue with the report, labeled `monthly-report`. It uses [issue-metrics](https://github.com/github-community-projects/issue-metrics), as the TC suggested on the August report (#38), so the monthly counts no longer have to be compiled by hand.

- Runs on the 1st of each month, and can be run manually from the Actions tab.
- Reports issues and pull requests created or updated during the month, with open/closed counts and time to first response and close.
- Both actions are pinned to a commit. The workflow only needs permission to read the repository and open an issue.

## Related Issue

Updates the TC feedback on #38 (monthly completion counts).

## Review Notes

The report counts all repository activity. Per-track counts can come later, by adding track labels and one query per track.

## Follow-ups

- After merge, run it once manually to produce the September counts for the September report (#58).
- Consider a label for items pending WG alignment, so the report can count them.
